questions.q: If H + I means H is the sister of I; H-I means H is the brother of I and H x I means H is the mother of I, which of the following means that J is the daughter of P?
questions.solution: In P×Q−J+M, P is Q’s mother, Q is J’s brother and J is M’s sister. Thus J is female and shares Q’s mother P.

questions.q: Choose the word from the given alternatives that cannot be formed using each letter of the given word 'PARANORMAL' only once.
questions.solution: PARANORMAL contains no E. RARE requires E, so it cannot be formed.

questions.q: Complete the analogy: $145 : 15^{4} :: 532 : ?$
questions.solution: Use the first and last digits as the base, and the middle digit as the exponent. Thus 145 gives 15⁴ and 532 gives 52³.

questions.q: Find the missing number in the series. 20, 35, 60, 105, 190, ____
questions.solution: Differences are 15,25,45,85. Each difference doubles and then decreases by 5. Next difference is 165; next term is 190+165=355.

questions.q: Priya started walking towards east for 20 m, then took left and walked for 40 m, then turned right and walked for 30 m. Now she turns right and walks for 40 m. How far is priya from her starting point?
questions.solution: The 40 m north and south movements cancel. Net eastward movement is 20+30=50 m.

questions.q: In a certain code, 'LEARNING' is written as '160'. How will 'PREPARATION' be written in that code?
questions.solution: Add alphabetical positions and double the result. LEARNING has total 80. PREPARATION has total 133, giving code 266.

questions.q: Arrange the following words as per their order in an English dictionary and choose the one that comes first: Hardboard; Handspring; Handover, Handstand
questions.solution: All Hand… words precede Hardboard. Within Hand…, o comes before s, so Handover comes first.

questions.q: Simplify the following expression using the given code language, where '+' represents 'x', 'x' represents '-', '-'represents '÷' and '÷' represents '+'. $9+4-6 \times 6 \div 8$
questions.solution: Replace the signs: 9×4÷6−6+8. Multiplication and division give 6, so result is 6−6+8=8.

questions.q: If the sequence of letters is A, F, K, P, ____, what comes next?
questions.solution: Advance five alphabetical positions each time. P advances to U.

questions.q: Complete the series. 2, 6, 12, 20, 30, 42, ____
Lion is to ____ in Den as Spider is to ____.
questions.solution: A lion lives in a den. A spider occupies a web.

questions.q: What comes next in the sequence? A, C, E, G, ____
questions.solution: These are alternate letters, advancing two places each time. G is followed by I.

questions.q: A family consists of 6 members A, B, C, D, E, F. B is the son of C, but C is not the mother of B. A and C are a married couple. E is the brother of C. D is the daughter of A. F is the brother of A. How many female members are there in the family?
questions.solution: C is B’s father and A is C’s wife. A and daughter D are female. B,C,E,F are male, giving two female members.

questions.q: Four letter-clusters have been given out of which three are alike in some manner, while one is different. Choose the odd one.
questions.solution: BDFH, PRTV and HJLN advance two positions each time. OQRT has gaps 2,1,2 and is different.

questions.q: Pointing towards a girl, Vipin says, "This girl is the daughter of the only child of my father." What is the relation of Vipin's wife Parvathy to that girl?
questions.solution: Vipin is his father’s only child, so the girl is Vipin’s daughter. Vipin’s wife is her mother.

questions.q: Complete the analogy: Camera: Photographer :: Microscope: ?
questions.solution: Match an instrument with its user. A photographer uses a camera; a biologist uses a microscope.

questions.q: How are dolphins and whales similar?
questions.solution: Dolphins and whales are mammals. Both breathe air through lungs rather than extracting oxygen through fish gills.

questions.q: Choose the letter pair which is different from others in the group.
questions.solution: MH, TO and GB each move back five alphabetical positions. OK moves back four.

questions.q: Series: 3, 5, 11, 29, 83, ____ What is the next number in the series ?
questions.solution: Multiply by 3 and subtract 4: 3→5→11→29→83. Next is 83×3−4=245.

questions.q: Find the next number in the series. 62, 55, 48, 41, ____
questions.solution: Subtract 7 each time. The next term is 41−7=34.

questions.q: Which of the following numbers is different from the rest ? 13, 17, 23, 27, 29
questions.solution: 27=3³ is composite. The other listed numbers are prime.

questions.q: If in a group of people, 40 like tea, 30 like coffee, and 20 like both tea and coffee, how many people like only tea?
questions.solution: Only tea =tea total−both =40−20=20.

questions.q: Pointing to a photograph Daisy said, "I have no sisters but that man's mother is my father's daughter." Whose photograph was it?
questions.solution: With no sisters, Daisy is her father’s daughter. The man’s mother is Daisy herself, so the photograph is of her son.

questions.q: Rani went 20 km towards west, then turned left and went 20 km. She again turned left and went 20 km. She took a 45 degree turn towards her left and went straight. In which direction is she walking now?
questions.solution: The directions are west, south and east. Turning 45° left from east points north-east.

questions.q: Read the following table and find the relevant code for '472938' as per the conditions given : Digit 2 5 7 8 9 4 6 3 1 Letter code M R T B W K D N J Conditions: 1. If both the first and last digits of the number are odd digits, then both are to be coded as 'S'. 2. If both the first and last digits of the number are even digits, then both are to be coded as 'Z'. 3. If one among the first and last digits is odd and the other one is even, then the first digit has to be coded as 'Q' and the last digit as 'W'.
questions.solution: First and last digits are both even, so replace their codes with Z. Middle digits 7,2,9,3 become T,M,W,N. Result: ZTMWNZ.

questions.q: Find the next number in the series 15, 36, 63, 96,
questions.solution: Differences are 21,27,33 and next 39. The next term is 96+39=135.

questions.q: Find the odd pair.
questions.solution: A lamb, calf and puppy are young forms of the paired animals. A turtle is not a young tortoise.

questions.q: From the given options, find the pair which is similar to the given pair. Projectile: Trajectory
questions.solution: A trajectory is a projectile’s path. An orbit is a satellite’s path.

questions.q: Answer the question according to the letter series given below. HDYSMWNBQPOCRTBLZVEGUF Which two neighbours in the given arrangement are farthest in the alphabetical order?
questions.solution: Alphabetical gaps are V–E=17, D–Y=21, U–F=15 and B–Q=15. D and Y are farthest apart.

questions.q: If you can form exactly one meaningful English word using the 1st, 5th, 6th and 8th letters of the word 'INFORMATION', what will be the fourth letter of that word?
questions.solution: The selected letters are I,R,M,T. They form TRIM, whose fourth letter is M.
